_comment: New field days added after rounds 4-8. Fill in on the night of the field day, then set enabled=true. single: MIDI stem (ending in ' L' or ' R') -> [drum, raw stem in <package>/Data/Raw]. songs: MIDI stem -> [kind (song|four_drum), raw stem]. pretest_midi: MIDI file name(s) of the pretest(s) in midi_dir, in the order of the pretest recordings (sorted by file name). Pretests are exam only.
